title: Cerebus Jaka’s Story Epilogue 2 Sep #138~ 1990 Aardvark-Vanaheim Comics
descriptionText: This comic book is a must-have for fans of Cerebus the Aardvark. It is the epilogue to Jaka's Story, issue number 138, published in September 1990 by Aardvark-Vanaheim. The artwork is by Dave Sim and Gerhard, and the genre is comics. The comic book is part of the Copper Age (1984-1991) era and has a tradition in US comics. It is a great addition to any collector's comic book collection.
